findings.requirement: Spec section 6: onOpen navigates to ${match.url}/ai via history.push
findings.description: The onOpen callback uses `match.url.replace(/\/[^/]+$/, "")` to strip the last path segment before appending `/ai`. Spec section 6 says: 'Use history.push(`${match.url}/ai`)'. The spec is explicit: use match.url directly, not a transformed version of it. The regex strip is a deviation from the spec regardless of whether it produces functionally equivalent navigation in practice -- spec says match.url/ai, implementation does something different. Whether this is functionally equivalent depends on the value of match.url at the call site (which is JobApplicationActivity rendered inside a Route whose path includes the view subpath, e.g. /overview), but the spec was written with knowledge of the call site and specified match.url directly. This is a spec-implementation mismatch.
findings.fix: Change the onOpen callback to: `onOpen={() => history.push(\`${match.url}/ai\`)}`
